blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Fuel products will see mixed adjustments in prices next week, so motorists are advised to plan and budget their fuel purchases. As for diesel products, they will have another round of price hikes next week due to escalating geopolitical conflict. READ: Attack on Saudi’s Dammam airport leaves 1 dead, 8 injured In an advisory on Friday, Jetti Petroleum president Leo Bellas said the prices of diesel may increase by P2 to P2.50 per liter.
